topics.title: Coursework
topics.summary: KTH student guidance says the teacher’s course-specific rule takes precedence. Four common approaches describe possible course policies, not permission for every assignment.
topics.scope: Course-specific instructions control graded work. Staff/template/legal guidance is scoped reference material with incomplete current-source verification; institutional AI services do not authorize assessment use.

claims.text: KTH tells students that generative AI use in graded assignments and exams should follow the course-specific information, and that the teacher's course rule takes precedence over general guidance.

evidence.quote: First and foremost, you must follow your courses' course-specific information about how generative AI may be used in graded assignments and on the exam. No information on this page takes precedence over what your teacher says applies.
evidence.title: Considerations for studying with generative AI

claims.text: KTH student guidance says course-specific generative AI information usually follows one of four approaches: no use, only specific assignments, allowed with guidelines, or free use.

evidence.quote: The information is usually based on one of four common approaches to the use of generative AI: No use of generative AI tools allowed; Only allowed in specific assignments; Allowed according to given guidelines; Free use of generative AI tools.
evidence.title: Course-specific information about generative AI
evidence.location: What is meant by course-specific information about generative AI?

evidence.quote: The ethical guidelines in each course plan states: "In any assessment, every student shall honestly disclose any help received and sources used.". Remind your students of this and have an open discussion with them about generative AI and your specific course.

claims.text: KTH staff guidance says its course-specific AI templates remind students that they are fully responsible for submitted material, explain when AI use must be accounted for, and warn that unauthorised generative AI use may lead to disciplinary action.

evidence.quote: The templates include: a reminder to students that they are fully responsible for all materials they submit; where relevant, how the use of generative AI should be accounted for; information that the unauthorised use of generative AI may lead to disciplinary action.

claims.text: KTH legal guidance advises clearing prompts of personal data and says use of generative AI with personal data requires verifying GDPR-related grounds, storage, third-party, and training-data questions.

evidence.quote: You are advised to clear prompts from personal data when using generative AI tools. coursework.en: KTH student guidance says the teacher’s course-specific rule takes precedence. Four common approaches describe possible course policies, not permission for every assignment.
coursework.zh: KTH学生指引要求优先遵循教师的课程规则。四种常见方案描述课程可能采用的政策，不是每项作业的使用许可。

exams.en: The retained student record covers graded assignments and exams under course-specific instructions. Service access and general guidance cannot override the exam’s rules.
exams.zh: 保留的学生条款要求计分作业与考试按课程具体指示执行；工具可用或一般指引不能覆盖考试规则。

disclosure.en: Teacher guidance asks staff to remind students to disclose help and sources honestly; templates address when AI use must be accounted for. Apply the relevant course’s actual requirements.
disclosure.zh: 教师指引要求提醒学生诚实披露获得的帮助和来源，模板说明何时须交代AI使用。具体义务仍按所属课程实际要求核对。

privacy_data.en: Staff guidance advises removing personal data, while legal guidance requires examining GDPR, storage, third-party and training conditions. Copilot guidance still excludes personal, sensitive or confidential material.
privacy_data.zh: 教师指引建议删除个人数据；法律指引要求检查GDPR、存储、第三方及训练条件。Copilot指引仍限制个人、敏感或保密材料。

approved_tools.en: A retained record describes employee-accessible Copilot Chat with a KTH account. It does not establish student entitlement; separate service records remain pending eligibility review and do not permit assessed use.
approved_tools.zh: 保留条款描述员工使用KTH账户访问Copilot Chat，未据此确认学生资格。独立工具记录仍待资格复核，也不构成考核许可。

research_publication.en: No retained public Claim establishes a specific KTH research-publication or authorship rule in this view. Course and staff guidance should not be expanded into such a rule.
research_publication.zh: 本视图保留的公开条款未确定KTH研究发表或署名的具体规则，不将课程与教师指引扩大为研究发表要求。

academic_integrity.en: Course templates retain student responsibility for submitted work and warn of disciplinary action for unauthorised AI use. No specific hearing procedure, sanction or appeal deadline is established here.
academic_integrity.zh: 课程模板保留学生对提交内容的责任，并警示未经允许使用AI可能引发纪律处理。本页未确认具体听证、处分或申诉期限。

teaching_guidance.en: Teachers are asked to consider how AI affects learning and write course-specific acceptable-use information. The excluded Faculty Council wording is not recast here as a binding university-wide mandate.
teaching_guidance.zh: 指引要求教师考虑AI对学习的影响，并编写课程可接受使用说明。已排除的Faculty Council措辞未在此改写为全校强制命令。

security_procurement.en: Employee recommendations call for checking duties, rules, agreements and ethical consequences before sharing information. Legal-data checks remain separate from course assessment permission.
security_procurement.zh: 员工建议要求共享信息前核对责任、规定、协议及伦理影响。法律与数据检查同课程考核许可分别成立。

basis.evidenceSnippet: First and foremost, you must follow your courses' course-specific information about how generative AI may be used in graded assignments and on the exam. No information on this page takes precedence over what your teacher says applies.

The information is usually based on one of four common approaches to the use of generative AI: No use of generative AI tools allowed; Only allowed in specific assignments; Allowed according to given guidelines; Free use of generative AI tools.

The templates include: a reminder to students that they are fully responsible for all materials they submit; where relevant, how the use of generative AI should be accounted for; information that the unauthorised use of generative AI may lead to disciplinary action.

You need to assess how the possible use of generative AI in your course can affect learning and thus the fulfilment of the intended learning outcomes. Based on this, write course-specific information aimed at the students about the acceptable use of generative AI.
Remove all personal data from the material you provide to the generative AI tool and ask your students to do the same.

You are advised to clear prompts from personal data when using generative AI tools. It is difficult to delete personal data once it has ended up in the training data of the tool, which makes a preliminary purge the safest and easiest method to ensure proper handling of personal data.

Before information is shared, responsibilities, regulations and agreements should be verified, and ethical consequences assessed. In case of uncertainty about data, agreements, laws or responsibilities, guidance should be sought from KTH's lawyers, the Data Protection Officer (DPO), the IT department or the Security Department.
As an employee at KTH, you have access to Microsoft Copilot Chat, which offers better information security than the free consumer version.
It is not permitted to share personal data, sensitive or confidential material in this type of cloud service.

The ethical guidelines in each course plan states: "In any assessment, every student shall honestly disclose any help received and sources used.". Remind your students of this and have an open discussion with them about generative AI and your specific course.

claim-kth-templates-content.scope: Course-specific instructions control graded work. Staff/template/legal guidance is scoped reference material with incomplete current-source verification; institutional AI services do not authorize assessment use.

evidence.quote: The templates include: a reminder to students that they are fully responsible for all materials they submit; where relevant, how the use of generative AI should be accounted for; information that the unauthorised use of generative AI may lead to disciplinary action.
evidence.location: The templates are available in Canvas

claim-kth-copilot-employee-tool.text: KTH identifies Microsoft Copilot Chat as an employee-accessible AI assistant with better information security than the free consumer version when used with a KTH account.
claim-kth-copilot-employee-tool.scope: Course-specific instructions control graded work. Staff/template/legal guidance is scoped reference material with incomplete current-source verification; institutional AI services do not authorize assessment use.

evidence.quote: As an employee at KTH, you have access to Microsoft Copilot Chat, which offers better information security than the free consumer version.

claim-kth-copilot-no-sensitive-data.text: KTH Copilot Chat guidance says the service still may not be used to share personal data, sensitive material, or confidential material.
claim-kth-copilot-no-sensitive-data.scope: Course-specific instructions control graded work. Staff/template/legal guidance is scoped reference material with incomplete current-source verification; institutional AI services do not authorize assessment use.

evidence.quote: It is not permitted to share personal data, sensitive or confidential material in this type of cloud service.

coursework.en: KTH student guidance says the teacher’s course-specific rule takes precedence. Four common approaches describe possible course policies, not permission for every assignment.
coursework.zh: KTH学生指引要求优先遵循教师的课程规则。四种常见方案描述课程可能采用的政策，不是每项作业的使用许可。
coursework.meaningEn: Course-specific instructions control graded work. Staff/template/legal guidance is scoped reference material with incomplete current-source verification; institutional AI services do not authorize assessment use.
coursework.meaningZh: 计分作业以课程具体指示为准。教师、模板与法律指引为限域参考，现行来源核验未完成；校内AI服务不授予考核许可。

exams.en: The retained student record covers graded assignments and exams under course-specific instructions. Service access and general guidance cannot override the exam’s rules.
exams.zh: 保留的学生条款要求计分作业与考试按课程具体指示执行；工具可用或一般指引不能覆盖考试规则。

disclosure.en: Teacher guidance asks staff to remind students to disclose help and sources honestly; templates address when AI use must be accounted for. Apply the relevant course’s actual requirements.
disclosure.zh: 教师指引要求提醒学生诚实披露获得的帮助和来源，模板说明何时须交代AI使用。具体义务仍按所属课程实际要求核对。

privacy_data.en: Staff guidance advises removing personal data, while legal guidance requires examining GDPR, storage, third-party and training conditions. Copilot guidance still excludes personal, sensitive or confidential material.
privacy_data.zh: 教师指引建议删除个人数据；法律指引要求检查GDPR、存储、第三方及训练条件。Copilot指引仍限制个人、敏感或保密材料。

approved_tools.en: A retained record describes employee-accessible Copilot Chat with a KTH account. It does not establish student entitlement; separate service records remain pending eligibility review and do not permit assessed use.
approved_tools.zh: 保留条款描述员工使用KTH账户访问Copilot Chat，未据此确认学生资格。独立工具记录仍待资格复核，也不构成考核许可。

research_publication.en: No retained public Claim establishes a specific KTH research-publication or authorship rule in this view. Course and staff guidance should not be expanded into such a rule.

academic_integrity.en: Course templates retain student responsibility for submitted work and warn of disciplinary action for unauthorised AI use. No specific hearing procedure, sanction or appeal deadline is established here.
academic_integrity.zh: 课程模板保留学生对提交内容的责任，并警示未经允许使用AI可能引发纪律处理。本页未确认具体听证、处分或申诉期限。

teaching_guidance.en: Teachers are asked to consider how AI affects learning and write course-specific acceptable-use information. The excluded Faculty Council wording is not recast here as a binding university-wide mandate.

security_procurement.en: Employee recommendations call for checking duties, rules, agreements and ethical consequences before sharing information. Legal-data checks remain separate from course assessment permission.
